title: Implement provider-neutral independent verification
businessObjective: Advance Phase 5 — Independent verification through one bounded verification outcome.
technicalObjective: Implement a provider-neutral VerificationProvider that independently checks executor results, task bounds, deterministic tests, and fail-closed outcomes.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: VerificationProvider accepts structured task, execution, and evidence references without trusting the executor's completion claim.
Verifier identity and execution are independent from the implementer/provider being reviewed.
Malformed, incomplete, timed-out, unavailable, or policy-inconsistent results fail closed and cannot become merge- or production-eligible.
The interface permits separately approved deterministic, hosted, or local verification implementations without changing completion authority.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the verification branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Generated from canonical phased implementation backlog.
